newsitem.title: CANADA: Parmalat extends Ault offer to July 15.
newsitem.headline: Parmalat extends Ault offer to July 15.

text.p: Italy's Parmalat Finanziaria SpA said late on Thursday that it extended its C$34 ($24.73) a share offer to acquire all shares of Canadian dairy firm Ault Foods Ltd from July 3 to 1600 EDT (2000 GMT) on July 15.
The extension of the roughly C$400 million ($294 million) deal allows all holders, including affiliates of 16.3 percent stake-holder Saputo Group Inc, to deposit shares.
Parmalat, Italy's largest publicly traded food company, came to the rescue of Toronto-based Ault after privately held Montreal-based Saputo had made a hostile bid of C$28 ($20.36) a share.
About 9.9 million, or 81.6 percent, of issued and outstanding Ault shares have been deposited, Parmalat said.
The offer was made by Parmalat Food Inc., a wholly owned unit of Parmalat Canada Inc. which is 75.1 percent owned by Parmalat and 24.9 percent owned by an affiliate of U.S. bank Citicorp.
Parmalat has been bent on extending its dairy empire in North America; earlier this year it acquired Canada's food maker Beatrice Foods Inc.
